# Tools and Skills are context too

Tool/Skill catalogs consume attention and influence routing.

Descriptions should make clear:
- what capability exists;
- when it should be used;
- important effect/authority boundary;
- enough schema semantics to invoke correctly.

Avoid exposing many overlapping tools with indistinguishable descriptions.

Prefer progressive discovery when the harness supports it.

Do not keep obsolete tools/Skills visible merely because they were installed previously.
